// tests/fixtures/service-split/Service.qml -- NOT a service. The one shared
// fixture of the service readers (D-REL-14): tests/service-files.js and
// scripts/service_files.py both read this directory as a plugin root, and
// inline.txt is the inline view they must both return, byte for byte, which
// is also the one-file text the split was cut from (the readers' tests cut it
// again and compare). Service-demo.js is its one code-behind.
pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound
import QtQuick
import "Model.mjs" as Model

Item {
  id: root
  property int count: 0
  readonly property string label: "{ not a brace }"

  Timer {
    id: tick
    interval: 10
    onTriggered: root.bump(1)
  }

  // Stays on the root: no code-behind holds it.
  function str(v) { return v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v) }

  // Stays too: a one-line call into the model is no forwarder, because the
  // model is no declared code-behind.
  function hosts(list) { return Model.hostsOf(list) }

  // The first moved function. Its comment block moves with it,
  // both lines of it.
  function bump(by) {
    root.count += by
    if (root.count > 3) tick.stop()
    return root.count
  }

  function quoted(a, b) {
    // A brace in a string, a template or a block comment opens no block.
    var s = "}" + '{' + `${a}}` /* } */
    return s + b
  }
  // ---- a banner the next function carries, directly attached
  function pattern(text) {
    var re = /[}{]\/+/g
    // CLOSURE-EXCEPTION: replace's callback, called before replace returns (D-REL-15)
    function count(m) { return "{" + m.length + "}" }
    return text.replace(re, count)
  }

  function stays(x) {
    return root.str(x) + root.label
  }

  function last() { return root.str(root.label) }
}
